summary: Shows everyone has seen: The Simpsons, Family Guy, Grey's Anatomy, NCIS and the Law & Orders are easy starts, Gunsmoke and Lassie the old surprises, and Friends (10 seasons) the trap.
reasons: Builder's own replay, pending a real judge. The casual found The Simpsons, Family Guy, Grey's Anatomy, Law & Order, SVU, NCIS and Criminal Minds, and lost lives on Friends, The Office, Supernatural (#12) and Bob's Burgers (#11), each with its seasons.

The title says network and scripted: South Park, SpongeBob, It's Always Sunny, SNL, Survivor and American Idol are free and never read as a list show. 'svu', 'greys', 'law and order' and 'csi' (offers the three CSIs) work.
